system.description: On a rest, forgo normal restoration — regain only (SL × 10) HP and MP and recover from (SL) statuses (Bond adjustment keeps) — to choose an area within one travel day (further if your travel means reach further): reroll its next travel die; ask one honestly-answered question; or pick up/deliver a package there.
